intro.title: Final exam
intro.line: Ten stones, one question each. Walk the whole path to earn your certificate.
intro.art: A stone gate in the garden at dawn; a path of ten stones leads through it toward the sun.

quiz.keys: Choose with mouse, touch, or keys 1 to {n}.

questions.q: What unit does AI read text in — and charge by?
options: By pages of text
By tokens — small word pieces
By minutes of chatting
By questions sent
questions.explain: AI cuts text into tokens; a chat's memory and its cost are both counted in tokens.

questions.q: Ask a chatbot the same thing twice and the answers differ a bit. Why?
options: It learns more after each question
A shaky network connection
It picks each word by probability
It changes things on purpose to avoid boredom
questions.explain: A chatbot guesses each next token by probability; a little randomness makes every answer slightly different.

questions.q: AI quotes a law for your contract and sounds very sure. What should you do?
options: Open the original text to compare
Paste it straight into the contract
Ask the AI: “Are you sure?”
Add the word “accurate” to the prompt
questions.explain: AI can “hallucinate” — make things up very confidently; check anything important against the original source.

questions.q: Where does a diffusion image AI start from?
options: A ready-made sample photo
A collage of images from the web
A pencil sketch
A screen of speckled noise
questions.explain: It removes noise step by step to fit the description — like mist clearing to reveal a painting.

questions.q: Why does AI video sometimes show warped hands, jittery text, melting objects?
options: The AI's virtual camera shakes
It's hard to stay consistent frame to frame
The video gets compressed on upload
The AI adds odd effects on purpose
questions.explain: Video AI denoises a whole block of frames; keeping hands, text and objects matching over time is still the hard part.

questions.q: You need a 3D serum bottle shoppers can spin on the web. Which AI gets the job?
options: Text AI (LLM)
Image AI
3D AI
Video AI
questions.explain: Each kind of AI has its specialty: an object you can spin needs a 3D model — and usually still needs a person to tidy it up.

questions.q: You ask AI to write an email to a client. What helps most?
options: Who'll read it, the goal, tone, length
The line “make it great and very professional”
Your email password so AI can send it
Lots of capital letters to be clear
questions.explain: Be clear, like briefing a new hire: role, context, task, limits, format — and keep sensitive data out.

questions.q: An agent tidying a shared folder is about to delete 200 files. What should come next?
options: Just delete — it was given the job
Delete first, tell you later
Ask another agent to check
Stop and wait for you to approve the list
questions.explain: Agents can take many steps on their own, but hard-to-undo actions — deleting, sending, paying — need a checkpoint for a person to approve.

questions.q: How does MCP help an AI agent?
options: A shared standard for connecting to apps
A newer, more powerful AI model
A safe way to store passwords
A filter that blocks AI's mistakes
questions.explain: MCP is like USB-C: one shared standard for AI to plug into Drive, Gmail, Figma… — grant only the access it needs.

questions.q: Which habit keeps AI use thrifty and your mind sharp?
options: Generate lots of versions, then pick
Think first, then ask short and clear
Let AI do the thinking to go faster
Always pick the biggest model
questions.explain: Every question costs power and water — times billions, that adds up; thinking first also keeps our minds from going lazy.
